test_title: PYST 15: SSC MTS 2023 - Reasoning (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following figure series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5b37fdbe07d62a0ef9234bf6b6496cfc3f4651782b5c1dbd5618d482afa75e4.png]
solution:
The figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series is shown below:

1) For first box alternate series : 

 
• Alternately first two elements of first and second column shifts in the clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately last element of first and second column and third column elements shifts in the anti-clockwise direction. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/24401b7d2ba172a79eadd482ebd827f8e27e56833f5153ddb7ef4d6df3f23439.png] 

2) For second box alternate series :

 
• Alternately top left corner element, center element and bottom right corner element are shifting in the anti-clockwise direction.
 
• Alternately top center element and bottom center element interchange positions.
 
• Alternately bottom left corner element and top right corner element interchange positions.
 
• Alternately center left element and center right element interchange positions.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a0ef8d68b712f44c4c08cd1f13591c33c636aff1743494be6b69aaff79d8e52.png] 

The final series is :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e991b4d52d9c8f706bfac73b5b0708675249d2e2b2ab802f0e3afd6c2cb4ea0.png] 

Hence, ‘option - (4)’ is the correct answer.
